Who we are

Bridging vision with execution

Strategic Leadership Global (SLGlobal) is a woman-owned consultancy dedicated to helping organizations and governments drive transformative, sustainable results in the world’s most complex environments.

We partner with senior leaders to align vision with execution, navigating high-stakes organizational change while strengthening performance and accountability. Whether coaching high-impact individuals, advancing business growth opportunites, or building leadership teams capable of delivering results at scale, we bridge the gap between strategy and impact.

Meet the founders

The people behind SLGlobal

Sara Borodin
Co-Founder & Managing Director

Sara Borodin is the Co-Founder and Managing Director of Senior Leadership Global (SLGlobal), a woman-owned small business dedicated to helping organizations and governments drive transformative, sustainable results in complex environments.

Prior to founding SLGlobal, Sara served at the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID) as a member of the Senior Executive Service. Most recently, Sara served as the Deputy Assistant Administrator for Asia where she provided policy and strategic direction for a $5 billion portfolio in 35 countries in Asia and the Pacific. Sara also served in other senior leadership positions at USAID including as Director for the Office of Middle East Affairs.

Sara is an International Coaching Federation (ICF) accredited Leadership Coach, having obtained her Executive Certificate in Leadership Coaching from Georgetown University in 2023. As a recipient of coaching herself, Sara believes that everyone can benefit from coaching. She specializes in executive coaching, leadership development, and coaching careers in transition.

Prior to joining USAID, Sara worked for a foreign policy think tank and the U.S. Institute of Peace in Washington D.C. She also worked as a program developer at a non-profit organization overseas.

Sara holds a Master’s degree in International Peace and Conflict Resolution from American University, and a Joint Honors Bachelor degree in Middle East Studies and Religious Studies from McGill University in Montreal, Canada.

Jessica Zaman
Co-Founder & Managing Director

Jessica Zaman is the Co-Founder and Managing Director of Senior Leadership Global (SLGlobal), a woman-owned small business dedicated to helping organizations and governments drive transformative, sustainable results in complex environments.

Prior to founding SLGlobal, Jessica served at the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID) as a member of the Senior Foreign Service. Most recently, she was the Deputy Mission Director for USAID in the West Bank and Gaza, where she led a multi-sector portfolio and a 100-person team operating in a highly volatile environment. Previously, she served in other senior leadership positions including directing USAID’s Office of Middle East Affairs, where she helped restart U.S. assistance programs and operationalize the Middle East Partnership for Peace Act—mobilizing significant resources and aligning policy with implementation across missions.

Her work spans Africa, Asia, the Middle East, and Latin America, bringing deep cross-cultural expertise and global perspective. Prior to USAID, she worked on Capitol Hill, at an international elections NGO, and in government relations. She is a graduate of the University of Virginia.

What we do

Strategic advisory for a complex world

We don’t just provide advice; we provide the intellectual leadership and operational experience required to solve global challenges.

01
Executive & Leadership Coaching

At SLGlobal, we empower leaders and high-potential talent to navigate high-stakes organizational shifts with clarity and purpose. Our coaching practice bridges the gap between individual values and professional excellence, specializing in emotional intelligence, adaptive leadership, and careers in transition.

We partner with public servants, NGO trailblazers, and private sector executives worldwide. Our coaches are trained by Georgetown University’s Institute for Transformational Leadership and hold International Coaching Federation (ICF) credentials, strictly adhering to the ICF Code of Ethics.

Specialized Services
  • 1:1 Confidential Executive Coaching
  • Career Transitions & Pivots
  • Leadership Development
  • Group & Team Coaching
  • Organizational Coaching Support
Why Choose SLGlobal
  • Global perspective across diverse cultures and international borders
  • ICF-certified methodologies backed by Georgetown’s world-class training
  • Purpose-driven — we focus on alignment between career and values
02
Strategic Planning & Implementation

SLGlobal provides the strategic direction and intellectual leadership necessary to manage multi-million dollar global programs. We are experts at navigating the complex processes required to align an organization’s mission with its human capital to produce measurable results.

  • Mission Alignment — every initiative tied to core organizational purpose
  • Complexity Navigation — expert management across foreign policy, national security, international development and humanitarian assistance
  • Execution Excellence — actionable frameworks that drive impact at scale
03
Change Management & Organizational Transformation

We specialize in leading large-scale organizational realignments through a transparent and inclusive process. Our approach optimizes operational workflows while providing the high-touch support individuals need to navigate the human side of change.

  • Institutional Resilience — strengthening foundational capabilities for long-term sustainability
  • Operational Optimization — enhancing organizational structures and streamlining internal processes
  • Adaptive Change — tailored services that help organizations pivot to meet new strategies and global demands
04
Leadership Development

As seasoned Executive Leaders, we work at both the institutional and individual levels to cultivate the next generation of leadership. We build leadership teams that are not only high-performing but also capable of delivering transformative results in complex global environments.

  • Executive-Level Advisory — working directly with senior leaders to strengthen performance, accountability, and vision
  • Team Synergy — developing leadership teams that operate cohesively across cultures and organizational boundaries
  • Capacity Building — empowering rising stars and mid-career professionals to step into high-stakes roles
